welcome.subtitle: An AI-powered, voice-first companion for older adults and those who care for them.
welcome.body: Bringing families and caregivers together in one thoughtful ecosystem of care and wellbeing.
welcome.signInHint: Use Google or your phone number to continue.

points.recite: Recite — prayer and calm, guided by voice
points.remind: Remind — medicines and routines, spoken aloud
points.rescue: Rescue — SOS that reaches your trusted family

welcome.terms: By continuing you accept the Terms and Privacy Policy.

googleModal.title: Continue with Google
googleModal.subtitle: Choose the Google account you use with Svaraa. We never post or see your password.

phone.title: Verify your phone
phone.subtitle: We use this for SOS and account recovery.
phone.addSubtitle: Add your mobile number to finish signing in. We use it for SOS and account recovery.
phone.devHint: Test mode: the code is 0000. A number ending in 00 signs in as an existing user; one ending in 11 is already taken.

claim.label: Claim

claim.sub: Each pendant has a one-time code on the card inside its box.

pair.label: Pair
pair.sub: Press the gold button once and connect over Bluetooth in under a minute.

contacts.sub: Choose who Svaraa alerts, and in what order. They don’t need the app.

drill.label: Test
drill.sub: Make sure alerts reach your contacts before you rely on it.

product.name: Svaraa Fold
product.body: An AI-powered, voice-first wearable for any and every use case you can imagine.
product.alt: Svaraa Fold pendant on its gold cord, studio product view

setup.title: Set up Svaraa
setup.stubBody: The setup steps are coming in a later release. For now this screen only lets you test saving and resuming progress.
setup.done: All steps done. The setup card is gone from Home.

profile.title: My Profile
profile.displayScaleHint: 1 is normal. 2 and 3 make text and app tiles a little larger if reading is hard. Buttons stay the same size to tap.
profile.backgroundHint: Placeholder looks for the Chat, Apps and Profile pages. Final art comes later.
profile.name: Name
profile.contactsLimit: Up to {{max}} contacts. Svaraa alerts them in this order.
profile.lastContact: Keep at least one emergency contact.

role.title: Who are you?
role.subtitle: This sets up the right steps for you.

unsure.title: Not sure yet / it's a gift

caregiver.title: Stay informed
caregiver.body: So you hear straight away if someone you care for needs help.
caregiver.note: Bluetooth and location are only needed on the wearer's phone, so we won't ask for them here.

denied.title: Notifications are off
denied.body: Open Settings, turn on notifications for Svaraa, then come back here.

permissions.title: Allow what Svaraa needs
permissions.body: Your phone connects to the pendant and sends SOS. We ask now so setup doesn't get interrupted.
permissions.whyBody: Your phone is the link between your pendant and your family. Bluetooth lets it talk to the pendant. Location is shared only during an SOS, so help can find you. Notifications bring you family alerts and SOS drills. We never use these for anything else.

location.title: Location, always
location.detail: Share where you are during SOS

battery.title: Battery exemption
battery.detail: Recommended. Keeps the pendant connected when the phone is idle.

denied.title: Something is turned off
denied.body: Open Settings, allow what is marked "Not allowed" for Svaraa, then come back here.

permissions.webNote: A web browser can't give Svaraa Bluetooth, location or notifications. You can continue now. Svaraa will ask for these on your phone later, before you pair the pendant.

about.title: About you
about.name: Your name

dobError.invalid: That date does not exist. Check the day and month.
dobError.future: The date of birth can't be in the future.
dobError.tooOld: Check the year. It is more than 120 years ago.

about.callAsHint: Only changes how the voice assistant speaks to you.
about.pacemaker: I have a pacemaker or ICD
about.consent: I agree to how Svaraa hears and records.

consent.title: How Svaraa hears and records
consent.hears: When you speak to Svaraa, your words are sent to trusted AI services so it can understand and reply.
consent.records: Only after you say "Svaraa". The pendant shows when it is listening.
consent.sees: People you invite see your status and alerts, and your location only during an SOS. You decide what they can do.

claim.title: Scan the code in the box
claim.where: It's on the card inside the box, under the pendant.
claim.owner: Claiming makes you the owner of this pendant. You can transfer it later.
claim.codeHint: Three groups of four letters or numbers.
claim.viewfinder: Camera viewfinder. Point it at the code on the card.
claim.cameraAsk: Svaraa needs the camera to scan the code.
claim.cameraDenied: The camera is turned off for Svaraa. Enter the code instead, or allow the camera in Settings.

taken.title: This pendant is already claimed
taken.owner: It belongs to a household owned by {{initial}}•••.
taken.next: Ask the owner to release it, or contact Svaraa support if you bought it second-hand.

pair.title: Pair your pendant
pair.retry: Press the gold button again and retry
pair.confirms: If your phone asks, tap Pair. The pendant confirms with one tick and a spoken "Connected".
pair.charging: Charging? Place the pendant on the magnetic puck.
pair.mockHint: No pendant nearby? Press the gold button once to simulate.

check.title: Check your pendant
check.body: Tick each one when it works.

contacts.title: Set up emergency contacts
contacts.body: If you need help, Svaraa alerts these people in this order.
contacts.limit: Up to {{max}} now. Add more later in My Profile.

contact.title: Add a contact
contact.name: Name
contact.howAlerted: Svaraa decides how to alert them: a call, and a notification if they use the app.
contact.numberInvalid: Enter a valid mobile number for this country.
contact.numberInvalidIndia: Enter a 10-digit Indian mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
contact.ownNumber: This is your own number. Add someone else who can help.
contact.duplicate: This number is already in your contacts.

invite.title: Invite someone to help
invite.body: They'll see your status and get alerts. You decide what they can do.
invite.expires: Expires in 24 hours. You approve them before they join.
invite.sent: Invite shared. They will show as waiting until you approve them.
invite.message: Join me on Svaraa so you can see how I'm doing and get my alerts. Open {{url}} or enter the code {{code}} in the Svaraa app.

drill.title: Test your SOS
drill.how: Press the gold button 3 times to start the drill.
drill.mockHint: No pendant nearby? Press the gold button 3 times to simulate SOS.
drill.overrideHint: Mark this drill as passed and continue without waiting for a contact.
drill.marked: Alerts are marked DRILL, so nobody worries.
drill.expiredBody: Check that your emergency contacts' numbers are right, let them know a drill is coming, and try again.

steps.emergencyLast: Last option if no contact answers
steps.emergencyDrill: In a real SOS 112 is called now. A drill never dials 112.

call.start: Call them yourself, one by one
call.ask: Your phone's dialer opened. Did {{name}} answer?
call.failed: This device could not open a call. Dial {{number}} yourself.
call.emergencyDrill: In a real SOS the last option is 112, emergency services. A drill never dials 112.

hero.nextIn: Moves to the next contact in {{time}}
hero.drillNote: A real SOS would call 112 now. A drill does not.

history.empty: Run an SOS drill and its result will be kept here.

ack.hint: Answer the drill from this phone, as a contact would.
ack.forbidden: A caregiver is in your household, so one of them needs to answer the drill.

wearerHome.keepClose: Keep the pendant close to this phone with Bluetooth on. SOS needs the connection.

chat.emptyHelp: Type a message, or choose Talk to speak with Svaraa.

suggest.walk: Remind me to walk at 7 AM

chat.listening: Listening… speak now. Tap the mic again to stop.
chat.micBlocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it for this site in the browser settings, then try again.
chat.micFailed: Couldn't hear that. Try again, or type your message.
chat.reply: I'm here. This is a sample reply until Svaraa's chat is connected.
chat.failed: Svaraa couldn't reply. Check your connection and send it again.
chat.deleteAllSure: Tap again to delete every chat
chat.deleteFailed: We could not delete your chats. Try again.

responses.intro: Quick replies Svaraa can send for you.
responses.noHistory: No chats yet. Your chats with Svaraa appear here.
responses.historyError: We could not load your chat history.

contacts.order: Emergency contacts, alerted in this order

voice.title: Voice with Svaraa

state.muted: Muted. Tap the microphone to talk again.

voice.hint: Just talk. Your words are kept in this chat when you finish.

demo.answer1: Light showers are likely after 3 PM. Take an umbrella if you go out in the evening.
demo.ask2: Remind me to take my tablet at 8.
demo.answer2: Done. I will remind you every evening at 8 PM. This is a sample conversation until Svaraa's voice is connected.

voice.hintLive: Just talk, and Svaraa answers out loud. For now Svaraa understands Hindi best, and the call is not saved in the chat.

error.blocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it for this site in the browser settings, then start the call again.
error.failed: Couldn't connect to Svaraa's voice. Check your connection and start the call again.

news.empty: No headlines here yet. Try again in a few minutes.
news.footer: Headlines from news websites, updated about every 15 minutes. Last checked {{time}}.

games.footer: Games to pass a few relaxed minutes. Scores are kept only while the app is open.

lotus.name: Heartbeat Run
lotus.blurb: Run along a heartbeat. Jump the thorns, catch the golden lights.
lotus.how: Tap anywhere (or press Space) to jump over the thorns. Catch the golden lights for 10 points each. The longer you run, the more you score.

match.name: Memory Match
match.blurb: Turn two cards at a time and find the matching pairs.
match.step1: Tap a card to turn it over.
match.step2: Tap a second card to find its twin.
match.scoring: Score: every pair you find is worth {{pair}} points. Every wrong try costs {{miss}}.
match.miss: Not a match, −{{count}}. Remember where they are.

petals.name: Petal Sequence
petals.blurb: Watch the petals light up, then tap them in the same order.
petals.step1: Watch the petals light up, one by one.
petals.step2: Then tap the same petals in the same order.
petals.step3: Each round adds one more petal. How far can you go?
petals.ok: Correct! Get ready for the next round.
petals.lost: Not quite. You completed {{count}} rounds. Try again!

reminders.empty: No reminders yet. Add one with the button below.
reminders.needsSetup: Reminders start once the pendant is set up.
reminders.pausedDetail: Paused: it will not ring until you resume it.
reminders.hint: Say “Svaraa, remind me…” to add one by voice.

schedule.notYet: Svaraa checks for reminders every 5 minutes.
schedule.more: and {{n}} more in the next 48 hours

reminders.sayHint: Keep it short. It is spoken exactly as written.
reminders.timeZone: The date and time are in this phone’s time zone.
reminders.runs90: A repeating reminder runs for up to 90 days. Renew it to keep it going.
reminders.persistDetail: Up to 3 times, 5 minutes apart, until the wearer says done

problem.badWindow: The end time must be after the start time.
problem.tooSoon: Pick a time at least 10 minutes from now.
problem.tooFar: Pick a time within the next 90 days.

made.chat: Added by asking Svaraa in chat.

alert.blocked: Browser notifications are blocked for this site. The beep and the banner still work. To get notifications, allow them in the browser settings.
alert.pageOpen: While this page is open, a beep and a message appear when a reminder is due.

manage.introNoName: Choose what appears on the Explore tab and what the pendant can start.
manage.sosBody: Anything playing stops when SOS starts.
manage.pending: These choices are saved on this phone for now. The pendant will follow them once the backend is ready.

music.notPlayable: This song is not ready to play yet. Try another one.
music.onPhone: Songs play on this phone. Tap a song to play it.

youtube.intro: Tap a row to play it inline. Use the bar on the video to scrub.
youtube.footer: Playback stays in the list. Scroll the collection if it is long.

spotify.intro: Connect Spotify to play your own music on this phone. Spotify Premium is needed to play.
spotify.introLead: Link the same account you use in the Spotify app. Then play, pause and browse from here or by asking Svaraa.
spotify.pointPhone: Plays on this phone or a speaker you already use
spotify.pointChat: Ask Svaraa for a song once you are connected

spotify.needsReconnect: Connect Spotify again to see your recent, most played and liked songs and your playlists. Playing still works.

notes.title: Notes
notes.intro: Record a conversation, like a doctor's visit or a family call. Svaraa writes it out and makes short notes in English and Hindi.

notes.private: Only you can see your notes.
notes.recordIntro: Keep the phone close to whoever is speaking. You can record up to 2 hours.

notes.micDenied: Svaraa cannot use the microphone. Allow it in your phone's settings, then try again.
